name: FutureFufu
tagline: A family brand, from the Founder's Collection era.

voice.tone: warm, personal, unhurried, story-first — a family brand, not a startup pitch
voice.personality: speaks like someone sharing something they made with care, inviting people in rather than selling at them.
do: Lead with the story or the person behind the piece, not the product spec
Use warm, unhurried language — this is a slow-build brand, not a hype cycle
Reference founding, heritage, the collection, the family behind it
Make early supporters feel like part of the founding story
dont: Never use e-commerce hype language ('LIMITED TIME', 'ACT NOW')
Don't be generic — every post should feel handmade and specific
sample_phrases: A family brand, built slowly and on purpose.
Early supporters are part of the story, not just the sale.
Heritage Builder, Legacy Founder, Generational Founder — every tier is a chapter.

aida.attention_hook: a piece of the founding story or a glimpse of the collection
aida.interest: what makes this a family brand rather than another product drop
aida.desire: being part of the founding cohort — Friend of FutureFufu through Generational Founder
